Quoted commas in `POST /import` are fixed. The full suite passes: 98 tests, 0 failures. The flaky `emits webhook on delivered` test didn't fail in this run.

**Cause:** `parseLegacyCsv` in `src/legacy/csvImport.ts` splits each line on every comma and ignores quotes. A name like `"Müller, Hans"` became two cells, so every later column shifted and the row failed validation.

**Fix:** `src/legacy/` is vendored and the platform team's sync overwrites it every Monday, so I didn't touch it.
- **New parser:** `src/lib/csv.ts` is quote-aware. It handles commas inside quotes, doubled quotes (`""`), newlines inside quoted fields, and CRLF line endings. It skips blank lines.
- **Same output:** `parseImportCsv` returns the same row shape as before. It reuses the legacy carrier mapping and the `LegacyRow` type, which are imported and not modified.
- **Route change:** `src/routes/import.ts` now calls `parseImportCsv` instead of `parseLegacyCsv`.

**Tests:** `test/import-quoted.test.ts` has four parser tests and one end-to-end `POST /import` test with `"Müller, Hans"`. The existing import tests still pass.

**Line numbers:** The error line numbers that `/import` reports are still record index + 2. If a quoted field contains a newline, later errors will point to a lower line number than the file's physical line.

I didn't update the ledger.

verify '## Now' against git, then reply in at most three lines (mission, where we are, next step) unless the user already gave you a task.
--- .gemkeeper/ledger.md ---
# Ledger — parcel-tracker

## Rules (user)
- NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old monolith; platform team's sync job overwrites it every Monday, so changes are silently lost.
- NO new npm deps, not even dev deps — each needs ~6-week security review. Node 24 runs TS directly, zero deps, no build step.
- Work autonomously; user reviews everything at the end.

## Now
- Done (uncommitted, 93 tests pass): holidays, ATP S10 validation, ERP body-field sig, ERP retries 3x/30s, eta in GET /shipments list (NOT in :id), request logging (no PII), debounced store writes + flush on SIGINT/SIGTERM, ERP payload renamed to event_type/occurred_at per docs.
- Done: calculateEta memoized (key = carrier|level|start|exceptions, bounded 10k, test/eta-cache.test.ts). Measured: ETA cost for a 500-item page 3.5 ms -> 0.3 ms; so ETA was NOT the cause of a slow list. Next: profile the real list request on staging data if still slow.
- Open: config/default.json erp.url still :8080 (sandbox is 9911) — asked user; 7 fixture ATP numbers have bad check digits; staging log 2026-11-12 contains recipient PII (DPO) — flagged.

## Decisions
- Holidays: hardcoded list for 2026+2027 in src/services/holidays.ts (user). Why: warehouse has no outbound internet, must work offline -> no holiday API.
- Flaky test 'emits webhook on delivered' (test/events.test.ts): timer race in fake notifier, ~1/5 fails, OPS-412, platform team owns fix. If it fails: rerun once, do NOT fix (user).
- Tracking validation: ONLY ATP gets S10 check-digit validation (docs/carriers.md); all other carriers accept any non-empty value. Why: formats change often; last year valid DHL numbers were wrongly rejected for 2 days (user).
- New user-facing error `message` fields must be GERMAN (packers' UI shows them verbatim); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE (user).
- ERP signing: HMAC-SHA256 hex, secret from env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Dead end: X-Signature header — ERP's API gateway strips all custom X- headers (found on staging). Now: top-level `sig` field IN the JSON body, computed over body JSON without `sig`; no header (user).
- Open: payload sends `type`/`at` but docs/erp-api.md wants `event_type`/`occurred_at` (old `type` accepted only until 2026-12-31) — not fixed yet.
- ERP retries: max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30s delay, no exponential backoff. Why: ERP dedups by event_id only within 2 min; all attempts must land inside that window. Retry on network error/5xx only. Delay must be injectable for tests (user).
- NO batching of ERP calls (user): ERP answers 422 to any array payload; only ONE event object per request (tried Sept 2026). Don't build/suggest again.
- GET /shipments/:id response must stay BYTE-FOR-BYTE unchanged (user): mobile app v2.3 uses a strict schema, crashes on unknown/missing fields; next release January. `eta` goes only into GET /shipments list items. Don't touch shared shipmentToApi in a way that leaks into :id.
- NEVER log recipient name/address/phone, anywhere (user). GDPR; data protection officer flagged it in last month's audit. Shipment IDs + tracking numbers are OK to log.
- Store stays a plain JSON file (data/store.json); NO SQLite/binary (user). Why: ops' nightly rsync backup diffs plain-text files. Perf fix = debounce writes 200 ms in src/store.ts + flush on shutdown (user).
- ERP sandbox now listens on port 9911 (since Oct infra move), NOT 8080 as docs/erp-api.md and README say (user). docs/erp-api.md is owned by the ERP team: DO NOT edit it. User fixes the README himself/herself. config/default.json still has erp.url localhost:8080 (flagged, not changed).
- Future (nothing to build now): config hot reload must use fs.watchFile (polling), NOT fs.watch. Why: staging config is a Dock
